title.en: Providing That the Special Fund Created Under Section 7 (J) of Republic Act No. 6173 as Amended Shall Not Revert to the General Fund Except Upon Specific Direction of the President

text.en:
Any provision of any special or general law or decree, including but not limited to Presidential
Decree No. 711, to the contrary notwithstanding, the special fund created under Section 7(J) of Republic Act
No. 6173 as amended shall not be abolished and or reverted and/or transferred to the General Fund of the
Government except upon specific direction of the President of the Philippines but shall remain and continue as
a special account available for continuing outlay by the President.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 16th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
